documents.name: Omer Miller Background
documents.source: Omer Miller is a popular Israeli chef and food content creator best known for his ketogenic recipes on Instagram. He promotes a low-carb, high-fat lifestyle through visually stunning food photography. His recipes often feature Mediterranean flavors combined with strict keto principles. Signature dishes include cauliflower tabbouleh, tahini-glazed salmon, zucchini fritters, and almond flour pita. He often shares macros and nutritional breakdowns with each recipe. Omer believes food should be both healthy and indulgent. He has collaborated with several Israeli health brands. His content mixes Hebrew and English to reach a wide audience. A typical Omer Miller keto breakfast might include eggs fried in olive oil with labane and herbs. He frequently posts meal prep tips and weekly menus. Omer encourages followers to transition gradually into ketosis. He is also known for keto-friendly takes on traditional Israeli dishes like shakshuka and hummus alternatives. His follower base spans fitness enthusiasts, diabetics managing blood sugar, and general health-conscious Israelis.
